score: reranker probability (LogisticRegression on [siglip_cos, m4c_cos, text_cos, text_missing]); NOT raw cosine
applies_to: image and image+text queries whose open-set gate decision is SUPPORTED and whose ML decision is 'candidate'. Text-only queries never auto-match.
data: CO3D held-out sequences: 90 objects, 360 queries (clean + phone-style perturbed), split by sequence
caveat: Query and gallery frames come from the same capture video (same session, lighting, background). 'perturbed' simulates a different camera but this is still optimistic versus campus reality. Validate on the campus protocol (docs/CAMPUS_VALIDATION.md). Test precision at this threshold is below the 0.95 target (0.91 on 22 auto-matches); treat as provisional until campus data exists.
